notes.title: MEGA PATCH - 1.3 + 1.4 Now Live
notes.content:
The MEGA PATCH is now LIVE. This patch is 1.3 and 1.4 combined and fixes the following points -

[i] *A bulk of the  audio bugs have been squashed!


* We dealt with achievements not unlocking. Your trophy cabinet shall now be filled! 

* The save system has been altered. Your crystal count will not change after Kao’s knocking out (we don’t want to say death, it sounds a bit grim doesn’t it?) 

* Implementation of  the Y axis inversion - We’re sorry this took so long, but happy to finally get it to you!

* Implemented a save icon that appears during gameplay - The future is NOW

* Fixed a number collision problems

* Addressed a number of performance drops

* Squashed a number of minor bugs[/i]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38658197/e6602efb4b814d716e8c1319f45060db3f9a61eb.jpg[/img]


Thank you very much for your patience, we've got some cool free content coming your way which we hope you will enjoy! Keep your eyes peeled!

notes.title: Kao The Kangaroo - Patch 1.2 - Save Fix & More
notes.content:
As part of our push to solve the problems currently facing Kao the Kangaroo, we are releasing patches as soon as they are ready for their respective platforms.

Our first patch is available via Steam solving the following issues.

1.2 Patch notes

[list]
[*] Save system fix – progression loss no longer occurs

[*] Fix for HUD disappearing after dying

[*] Audio fixes – Music is now played properly after exiting Eternal Wells
 
[*] Localization fixes
[/list]


Thank you for your patience. Stay tuned for further updates!

tags.bug: Save system fix – progression loss no longer occurs
Fix for HUD disappearing after dying
Audio fixes – Music is now played properly after exiting Eternal Wells

notes.title: An update on Kao the Kangaroo
notes.content:
We hear and see you

We moved mountains to make Kao The Kangaroo’s release on all major platforms globally on day one not just a possibility, but a reality. As a small team, we faced a number of moving parts when it came to creating and releasing the game.

We’re aware of the bug affecting people’s saves and are hard at work patching this problem. We aim to have the patch out this week. 


We will be releasing further patches to address other issues, we’ll keep you updated.
